g.text: WordExtractor — shared-reference writes over a sharded map
snapshot the map after the workers join
write lock. With S shards and P
workers, the chance two workers collide on a step is ≈ 1/S
under a uniform hash, so contention falls as S grows — but a
hot word (Zipf's "the") still serialises on its shard.
Relaxed is sound here: fetch_add is
exact. Relaxed only forgoes ordering *with respect to other data*,
which no reader of these counters relies on.
folds a second extractor in, summing per-word
counts and both counters — so a shard-per-thread design that
avoids the shared map entirely is a two-line change.
